title: Copy directory contents without the directory itself
summary: Copy the files inside a folder to another location, but do not create the source folder name in the destination. This is done by adding a trailing slash to the source path.

steps.explain: Recursively copy the contents of the source directory to the destination. The trailing slash on the source ensures only the contents are copied, not the directory itself.

placeholders.name: SOURCE
placeholders.description: Path to the source directory (note the trailing slash)
